FeinwerkDataExploration.SettingMaxVisitsHelp: Above this number an exploration does not run, and the user is asked to choose a shorter period.

FeinwerkDataExploration.SettingMinimumRoleHelp: The lowest role a user needs on a website. Anonymous users can never use explorations.
FeinwerkDataExploration.ErrorSettingRange: Please enter a whole number between %1$s and %2$s.

FeinwerkDataExploration.LargePeriodHint: This period has about %1$s visits. Explorations with pages, events or other actions read many more rows than visits and can take a while or stop at the time limit of %2$s seconds. A shorter period or a segment makes them faster.

FeinwerkDataExploration.SlowQueryHint: This exploration took %1$s seconds (time limit %2$s seconds). It gets faster with a shorter period, a segment, or a visit dimension instead of pages or events. Results are kept for an hour, for five minutes while today is included.
FeinwerkDataExploration.SlowQueryHintNoLimit: This exploration took %s seconds. It gets faster with a shorter period, a segment, or a visit dimension instead of pages or events. Results are kept for an hour, for five minutes while today is included.
FeinwerkDataExploration.ErrorRollUp: Explorations need the raw data of a website. A roll-up has none of its own: please choose one of its websites.
FeinwerkDataExploration.ErrorTimeoutSuperUser: The exploration took longer than %s seconds and was stopped to protect Matomo. Please choose a shorter period, add a segment, or use a visit dimension instead of pages or events. As a super user you can raise the time limit in the plugin settings or let explorations run on a read replica.
FeinwerkDataExploration.ErrorTooManyVisitsSuperUser: This period has more than %s visits, more than an exploration reads at once. Please choose a shorter period. As a super user you can change this threshold in the plugin settings.
FeinwerkDataExploration.MetricDescriptionConversions: The number of conversions in these visits, of all goals or of the chosen goal.
FeinwerkDataExploration.MetricDescriptionRevenue: The revenue of the conversions in these visits, of all goals or of the chosen goal.
FeinwerkDataExploration.MetricDescriptionDownloads: The number of times a file was downloaded.
FeinwerkDataExploration.MetricDescriptionOutlinks: The number of clicks on links to other websites.
FeinwerkDataExploration.MetricNoteUniqueVisitors: Explorations count them exactly over the whole period, also for weeks and months.
FeinwerkDataExploration.ShowFromFirstCompleteDay: Show the period from this day
FeinwerkDataExploration.SettingsLimitsIntro: Limits: explorations read raw data. Higher values let them read more and put more load on your database; 31 days and 1,000 rows are the maximum.
FeinwerkDataExploration.SettingUseReaderNoReaderHelp: No read replica is configured ([database_reader] in config.ini.php), so explorations run on the main database. Once one is configured, they use it when this is on.
FeinwerkDataExploration.SmallerPeriodNone: Even a single day of this period has more visits than an exploration reads at once. Your Matomo administrator can raise this threshold.
FeinwerkDataExploration.RowBreakDown: Break down by a second dimension

FeinwerkDataExploration.NoVisitsForRow: This row has no segment (date, weekday, hour or an unknown value).
FeinwerkDataExploration.ExploreRowHelp: Opens an exploration on the visits of this row, to break them down by a second dimension.
FeinwerkDataExploration.DiagnosticReplica: Explorations run on the read replica.
FeinwerkDataExploration.DiagnosticNoReplica: No read replica is configured ([database_reader] in config.ini.php), so explorations run on the main database. On large instances a read replica keeps them away from tracking and archiving.
FeinwerkDataExploration.DiagnosticReplicaOff: The plugin settings let explorations run on the main database, not on a read replica.
FeinwerkDataExploration.DiagnosticTimeLimit: The database stops an exploration after %s seconds.
FeinwerkDataExploration.DiagnosticNoTimeLimit: The database cannot stop long queries (MySQL 5.7.8 or MariaDB 10.1 and newer can). Explorations are then only limited by the number of visits per period; consider a lower threshold.
FeinwerkDataExploration.DiagnosticRawDataDeleted: Raw data older than %s days is deleted regularly; explorations cover the days after that.
FeinwerkDataExploration.DiagnosticRawDataKept: Raw data is kept; explorations can cover any period of up to the longest period in the settings.
FeinwerkDataExploration.DiagnosticLimits: Limits: %1$s days per exploration, %2$s rows, %3$s visits per period, %4$s explorations at the same time.
FeinwerkDataExploration.SmallerPeriodNoneSuperUser: Even a single day of this period has more visits than an exploration reads at once. As a super user you can raise this threshold in the plugin settings.
FeinwerkDataExploration.NoFilterForRow: This row stands for visits without a value or a value longer than 1,000 characters, a filter cannot select it.

FeinwerkDataExploration.SupportTitle: Opens the Feinwerk contact form in a new tab
FeinwerkDataExploration.PromoCampaignsText: UTM builder and naming conventions for your team, so that campaigns arrive in Matomo cleanly.
FeinwerkDataExploration.PromoHostingText: Feinwerk runs your Matomo instance in German data centers, with updates, backups and monitoring, and the move is included.
FeinwerkDataExploration.PromoCapiText: Feinwerk Conversions API sends orders and goals from Matomo server-side to Google Ads, Meta, LinkedIn, X and Microsoft Advertising, only with consent and without ad pixels on your website.
FeinwerkDataExploration.PromoSentinelText: The free plugin Feinwerk Sentinel watches your Matomo data around the clock and alerts you by email, Slack or Teams as soon as goals stop or tracking breaks.
FeinwerkDataExploration.CopySkippedAccess: Not copied to %1$s: you cannot use explorations on this website.
FeinwerkDataExploration.CopySkippedGoal: Not copied to %1$s: this website has no goal with the same name.
FeinwerkDataExploration.CopySkippedDimension: Not copied to %1$s: this website has no active custom dimension with the same name.
FeinwerkDataExploration.CopySkippedSegment: Not copied to %1$s: the segment does not work on this website.
FeinwerkDataExploration.CopySkippedLimit: Not copied to %1$s: you already have %2$s saved explorations there.
FeinwerkDataExploration.CopyChooseOtherSite: Please choose another website: the exploration is already saved on this one.
FeinwerkDataExploration.ErrorFunnelStep: Step %s is not valid. A step needs a type, a condition and a text of up to 1,000 characters, or a goal.
FeinwerkDataExploration.ErrorFunnelGoal: Step %s names a goal this website does not have.
FeinwerkDataExploration.FunnelHelp: Describe the steps of a path through your website, such as a page, an event and a goal, and see how many visits reached each step in this order. Other actions in between are allowed. The funnel is calculated from the raw data of the chosen period, so it needs no setup in advance.
FeinwerkDataExploration.FunnelNoSteps: Describe at least two steps. A text step needs a text, a goal step a goal.
FeinwerkDataExploration.ErrorComparisonCount: Please compare at most %s columns per metric.
FeinwerkDataExploration.CompareChartHint: The chart shows your own view. Comparisons appear in the table.
FeinwerkDataExploration.DonutNeedsCount: A donut shows counts and sums
FeinwerkDataExploration.DonutNeedsSum: The rows of this table can add up to more than the total
FeinwerkDataExploration.TrendFirstRows: The trend shows the first %1$s of %2$s rows.
FeinwerkDataExploration.CompareTrendHint: The lines show the total of each comparison column. Without a comparison the trend shows the rows.
FeinwerkDataExploration.PromoConnectorText: Exclusive Plugins for Matomo by Feinwerk, free, freemium and premium:
FeinwerkDataExploration.PromoConnectorLink: Install the Feinwerk Connector from the Matomo Marketplace
FeinwerkDataExploration.PremiumAskSuperUser: Your Matomo super user can install it.
FeinwerkDataExploration.PaidPluginAuthSamlText: Auth SAML connects Matomo to your identity provider: SAML 2.0 single sign-on, SCIM 2.0 on- and offboarding and site permissions driven by your IdP groups. For Okta, Microsoft Entra ID, Keycloak and any SAML provider.
FeinwerkDataExploration.PaidPluginChannelGroupingText: Group hundreds of traffic sources into the marketing channels you actually steer: Organic, Paid, Email, Social or your own.
FeinwerkDataExploration.PaidPluginConversionsApiText: Conversions API sends your Matomo goals and ecommerce orders server-side to Google Ads, Meta, LinkedIn, X, Microsoft Advertising, ChatGPT Ads and TikTok: with consent per platform, automatic click attribution and close to real time.
FeinwerkDataExploration.PaidPluginEmailReportsProText: Email Reports Pro turns your Matomo data into designed email reports: key figures with their trend, clear charts and tables that make even multi-level reports readable. You put every report together from building blocks and see in the preview how the email arrives.
FeinwerkDataExploration.PaidPluginSearchReportText: Search Report imports Google Search Console and Bing Webmaster Tools into native Matomo reports: daily, automatically, with unlimited history beyond Google's 16-month limit.
FeinwerkDataExploration.PaidPluginSentinelProText: Sentinel Pro adds visit forecasts, public holidays and alarms per channel and conversion rate to the free Sentinel, plus a watchdog that speaks up when Sentinel itself stops.
FeinwerkDataExploration.PaidPluginTrackingRouterText: Keep every website in its own profile and add a shared profile with continuous sessions: one tracking request, copied on the server to the sites you allow.
FeinwerkDataExploration.PaidPluginTrackingSpamScoreText: Spots bot traffic by how whole groups of visits behave, shows it per network and blocks it while tracking, server-side.
FeinwerkDataExploration.PaidPluginVisitJourneyText: A funnel with no presets: Visit Journey shows, for every goal and every order, which steps really came before it: pages, events, other goals and the channel the visit came through, as an interactive flow chart in Matomo.
FeinwerkDataExploration.ConnectorInstallerIntro: With the free Feinwerk Connector you install, update and license Feinwerk plugins right inside Matomo.
FeinwerkDataExploration.ConnectorInstallerInstallText: Matomo downloads the connector from its Marketplace, installs it and then activates it.
FeinwerkDataExploration.ConnectorInstallerActivateText: The connector is already installed but not activated yet.
FeinwerkDataExploration.ConnectorInstallerPasswordNote: As with every plugin install, Matomo first asks for your password if you have not entered it recently.
FeinwerkDataExploration.ConnectorInstallerManual: This Matomo cannot install plugins from its Marketplace by itself. To install the connector by hand:
FeinwerkDataExploration.ConnectorInstallerManualStep2: Unzip it and put the folder FeinwerkMarketplaceConnector into the plugins directory of your Matomo.
FeinwerkDataExploration.ConnectorInstallerManualStep3: Activate the connector under Administration, Plugins.

FeinwerkDataExploration.ConnectorInstallerPhp: The Feinwerk Connector needs PHP %s or newer. Once your server runs it, you can install the connector here.
FeinwerkDataExploration.ConnectorInstallerWordPress: In Matomo for WordPress the Feinwerk Connector is installed as a WordPress plugin: open Matomo Analytics, Marketplace in WordPress and search for Feinwerk.
